curriculum.A_cur: phase1 force-seq ε → phase2 joint ε+π
curriculum.A_cur_freeze: phase1 force-seq ε → phase2 π only (ε frozen)

implementation.cyc_proxy: finite FIPS-style: zw!=0 and [zw] a basic-Event ray; NOT full continuous C
implementation.soft_train_exact_eval: soft Cyc score during training; exact hard proxy + projective ray equality at evaluation
implementation.vocab_selection: same greedy densest FIPS subgraph as 017.10/017.12, n_vocab=16
implementation.arms: A_cur / A_cur_freeze / A_joint / B / C + Oracle

task.kind: native-structure from fixed hidden OT-compatible denotations
task.target_rule: grp when seq/grp disagree and grp defined; else seq (else grp if seq undefined)
